datasets.name: Gaskell Phobos Shape Model V1.0 (vertex-facet, quantised)
datasets.organization: Robert Gaskell (Planetary Science Institute), archived at NASA PDS Small Bodies Node
datasets.purpose: True 3D shape of Phobos for the moon close-up (stereophotoclinometry mesh)
datasets.mechanism: Downloaded phobos_ver128q.tab from the PDS4 archive and converted offline by scripts/data/moons/build-phobos-shape.mjs into a compact binary mesh
datasets.version: Gaskell Phobos Shape Model V1.0 (PDS4 urn:nasa:pds:gaskell.phobos.shape-model::1.0), phobos_ver128q.tab
datasets.license: NASA PDS data, public domain / free to use with citation (as stated in the build script header).
datasets.citation: Gaskell, R., 'Gaskell Phobos Shape Model V1.0', VO1-SA-VISA/VISB-5-PHOBOSSHAPE-V1.0, NASA PDS Small Bodies Node, 2011.
datasets.rateLimits: n/a (single static file download; PDS archive publishes no numeric limit - not recorded)
datasets.normalization: scripts/data/moons/build-phobos-shape.mjs: source 99,846 vertices / 196,608 facets; unused duplicate edge/corner vertices dropped (98,306 kept); vertices quantised to int16 (+-32767 = +-maxRadiusKm, 13.94 km), quantisation error < 0.4 m; little-endian 'SHP1' header, u32 nVerts, u32 nFaces, f32 maxRadiusKm, i16[3*nVerts], u32[3*nFaces] (0-based). Frame: Gaskell body-fixed, +z north, +x prime meridian.
datasets.fallback: Phobos keeps its illustrative ellipsoid shape when the mesh fails to load (moonsLayer.ts loadShape).
datasets.limitations: Stereophotoclinometry from Viking Orbiter 1 and Phobos 2 images; a model fitted to images, not a direct survey, and quantised to under 0.4 m.
